product.description: The Aurelio ThermoSense 3.0 offers precise temperature control for modern homes. Its slim 12×8×3 cm chassis houses an integrated Wi‑Fi 802.11b/g/n module and a Zigbee 3.0 radio, enabling seamless mesh networking with other smart devices. The device operates on a low‑power 5 W consumption profile, extending battery life when used in backup mode. A high‑definition glass display shows real‑time temperature, humidity, and energy usage statistics. The thermostat supports voice assistants via API and can be programmed through a companion app for daily schedules, vacation modes, and energy‑saving alerts. Its aluminum‑reinforced body and durable plastic housing ensure longevity in varying climates.
